articles.title: Russia: Washington has not yet formally responded to Putin’s proposals on the nuclear treaty
articles.summary: Russia announced it awaits a formal US response to President Putin’s proposal for jointly upholding the last remaining major nuclear arms control treaty. This agreement is crucial for maintaining global strategic stability and preventing an unconstrained arms race between the world’s two largest nuclear powers. Dialogue remains key.
